'''Xirossk''' was a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] who served in the [[Cularin Militia]] as a [[Major/Legends|Major]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and commanded its [[Militia Intelligence]] division. He once coordinated an operation to locate bases used by the [[Wyrd]] in the [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] jungle.

He later helped organize a mission to attack a [[Believers]] base.
